title: ops content publish reports failure on a 30 second client timeout while the page-building Lambda is still writing pages
description: papyrus ops content publish prints 'FAILED to project the page: the data is published but the page is not live (The read operation timed out)' when the page-build step outlasts the CLI GraphQL timeout (default 30 s, PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). The content-actions Lambda runs up to about 75 s and completes the write anyway, so the report is wrong and operators retry. Fix: a longer default for the projection call, or return a job id and poll; report 'still running' distinctly from 'failed'. Seen on machines-on-machines 2026-11-08 across about 20 publishes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/PPY-2745c1-publish-stages, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1304 (stacked on #1302). Verified with fakes only (pytest + behave, see PR); nothing run against real AWS. Needs deploy: content-actions function per site.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-13: PR #1498 (merged to develop) moves ops content rerender and the re-render that stories link-story / link-concept trigger onto the publish job mechanism from #1304: refreshSitePages takes async and returns a jobKey, the CLI polls jobStatus and reports done / failed / still running (exit 5, not failed) / outcome unknown, with ops content rerender --status to ask again. Publish was covered by #1304. Live once a release ships the content-actions handler; a CLI newer than the backend is refused by the old handler (async is unknown there). Not closed until that release is deployed and seen working.
